purpose: Separate performance metrics, statistical uncertainty, mechanism analysis and supplementary diagnostics for the frozen Adaptive-minus-Fixed accuracy question.
primary_outcome_unchanged: Final-test generation accuracy: adaptive_mix minus fixed_mix

reporting_order.content: Generation accuracy for Teacher, original Student and six conditions; individual observed seeds and mean +/- sample SD.
Adaptive-minus-Fixed accuracy difference in percentage points and existing paired 95% question-bootstrap CI.
Actual adaptive branch fractions by epoch/seed and teacher-error patterns with denominators; no causal claim.
Objective loss and common gold CE/accuracy on fixed seed-42 diagnostic subsets; no checkpoint selection.
Choice NLL at T=1 over valid answer letters; not a co-primary outcome, sequence NLL or calibration alone.
Brier, ten-bin choice ECE, reliability, exploratory metric CIs, clipping, timing, VRAM and model size.

statistical_method_unchanged.pairing: Same question indices in all conditions and seeds; average three observed seeds per question.
statistical_method_unchanged.ci_scope: Conditional on observed seeds; not uncertainty over new training seeds.
statistical_method_unchanged.seed_sd: Sample SD, ddof=1; separate from question-bootstrap CI.

no_changes_to: six conditions and three training seeds
existing raw results and metric CIs
limitations: Reporting hierarchy clarified after viewing interim validation; all original metrics remain available.
Adaptive-minus-Fixed validation and all test evaluation remain pending.
Teacher-error validation subsets have only 22 and 7 questions; descriptive analysis only.
Published plots are interim snapshots, not live pipeline outputs.
automatic_report_note: Frozen analyze_kl.py computations and report writer are retained; publication snapshots are arranged manually for this reporting clarification.
